question: Should core reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root, or must installed plugin ownership of that root remain authoritative?
rationale: This changes a supported plugin namespace contract, so the permanent ownership policy requires CLI/plugin owner intent rather than an automated compatibility guess.

options.title: Preserve plugin root ownership
options.body: Keep the canonical `models auth list` path or add a generic alias that yields when a plugin owns `auth`.

options.title: Reserve `auth` for core
options.body: Accept the namespace break only with explicit owner approval, upgrade documentation, and real proof covering an installed plugin that registers `auth`.

recommendation.title: Preserve plugin root ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical `models auth list` path or add a generic alias that yields when a plugin owns `auth`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged CLI work established the affected plugin-root ownership and overlap behavior.
